== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[Responsibility Of Command (PC Errata 2017 slip)]]. Compared with [[Responsibility Of Command (PC Errata 2016 disc card)]] (by 29 December 2016). The disc card (lower part, scaled to the slip's width) and the 2017 slip; nothing else is edited. Made by placing the two crops side by side (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).
